research.question: Did the municipality have an explicit, formal Swedish-language proficiency requirement for staff in elderly care in operation before 1 January 2025? Identify the proficiency threshold, staff covered, enforcement and historical timing.
research.instructions: Include municipal elderly-care employers and clearly identified municipal contractors. Distinguish new hires from existing staff and municipality-wide rules from one unit. General expectations of good Swedish are not necessarily a formal tested threshold. A language-test pilot does not make an already established requirement a pilot. Code implementation of the underlying requirement separately from testing methods. A decision made in 2024 with implementation in 2025 is not a pre-2025 requirement. A dated account explicitly saying a rule already applies can establish that it was in force by that date, even if the exact introduction date is unknown. Leave effective_date null in that case. Never infer introduction from publication alone.

Yes.definition: Explicit formal requirement shown to be in operation before the cutoff.

Pilot.definition: The requirement itself, not just a testing instrument, was piloted before the cutoff.

No.definition: Explicit evidence that no such formal requirement applied in the defined pre-cutoff period and scope. Never infer this from a failed search.

Later.definition: Explicit implementation only at or after the cutoff; no established pre-cutoff operation in this evidence.

Proposed.definition: Proposal or adoption decision without evidence of implementation in the target period.

Unclear.definition: Relevant rule or activity is mentioned, but its historical timing, formality, attribution or scope remains uncertain.

NoEvidence.definition: This retrieved material supplies no usable evidence to answer the question. This does not mean the municipality had no requirement.

Irrelevant.definition: Material is outside the specified municipality, elderly-care employment scope or research topic.

fields.language_level: Explicit CEFR/GERS, SFI or Swedish course threshold; preserve the source's terminology.
fields.staff_group: New hires, existing staff, all staff, named occupations or another explicit group.
fields.enforcement: How compliance is tested or enforced, if explicitly stated.
fields.provider_scope: Municipal employer, municipal contractor, a specific unit or another explicit scope.
